final: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS average_ratio, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS average_ratio FROM media_averages) SELECT AVG(ma.average_ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(ma.track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(ma.average_ratio - oa.average_ratio) AS average_difference FROM media_averages AS ma CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa WHERE oa.average_ratio IS NOT NULL AND ma.average_ratio > oa.average_ratio
